name: cat-synthetic-toxins/ingest-task
goal: Verify a synthetic compound's toxicity to cats and emit one YAML entry that satisfies this repository's schema.
language_of_output: zh-CN except where the schema requires English
rules: Every claim must come from a page you actually opened.
Never transfer dog or human doses to cats.
Never round, estimate, or convert units.
quote must be a verbatim English sentence findable on the cited URL.
Product ingredient lists are not toxicity evidence.
If no feline dose exists, write '无可靠数值' and say which sources you checked.
procedure: Find 1-2 relevant pages per allowed site (site search or search engine with site: filter).
Open each page and confirm it discusses cats (search 'cat' / 'feline').
Locate dose sentences containing mg/kg, mL/kg, 'as little as', 'small amount', 'single tablet', 'lethal'.
Copy the whole English sentence verbatim.
Re-search that sentence inside the page to confirm it exists.
danger_level_formula: 极高 if form_risk in (高,极高) and commonness in (常见,一般) and toxicity_level == 极高; 中 if form_risk == 中 and toxicity_level == 中; else 高

dose_format.with_number: <value> <unit>（<route>，<basis>）, basis ∈ {LD50, 最小致死剂量, 中毒剂量, 病例报告}
dose_format.qualitative_only: cat_lethal_dose: 无可靠数值 + cat_dose_note: <一句话中文>

output: A single YAML block with exactly one list item; no prose around it.
handoff: Ask the user to send the YAML to the repository author. Do not claim it was submitted.
